title: EntryLinkView
description: Source of truth: Holochain agent source chain in imagodei DNA (Agent-Scoped, Category B). Links are authored by the agent and live on its source chain. This view is read via the `query_my_source_chain_links` coordinator function and served by GET /api/v1/source-chain/{agentId}/links.

linkHash.description: Hex-encoded ActionHash of the create-link action on the source chain.

baseHash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the base of the link (AnyLinkableHash).

targetHash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the target of the link (AnyLinkableHash).

linkType.description: Link type discriminator as a string derived from the link_type field of the CreateLink action.

tag.description: Optional serialized tag bytes, hex-encoded. Null when the link was created without a tag.

authorAgent.description: Hex-encoded AgentPubKey that authored this link.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this link was created on the source chain.

deleted.description: True when a delete-link action for this link hash appears later in the source chain.

deletedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the delete-link action. Null when not deleted.
